I'm proud to announce that Scribble's next version (1.5) is now officially in beta. You can check out the latest updates here, in our Github repository. This update includes the following fixes:

  • Fix sidebar scrollbar being partially hidden
  • Image expandos will be able to cover the sidebar, now
  • Comment and self post body widths will be limited to 800 pixels wide, to promote legibility. Thanks to /u/AmyAcker for the suggestion
  • Mobile header updated to be transparent, and blend in with the background. Addon to change it back to the old look is in the pipeline, and will be here before release.
  • Make "My Subverse" drop down expand the page, so it doesn't go past the bottom of the page and make it impossible to get to some links

While this may not seem like a massive update, there are plenty of things in here that change a lot of the CSS behind the scenes. With so many things changing, I need beta testers, and that's where you come in! This is a major release, and since we have so many users seeing this theme every single day (200,000 per day, and growing!), I want to be sure this is as perfect as we can get it before it gets in the hands of the moderators and developers out there that want to make it their own. If you find a bug, post it on this subverse. If it's a confirmed bug, and the fix goes in before release, I'll add your name to the list of major contributors, and you'll get a unique flair for this sub!

So how's about it, folks? Go get your updated base CSS and addons, today, and let's find all of the bugs we can before we push this to the hundreds of thousands of users that see Scribble every single day! Thank you all so much for your hard work with developing this theme, and helping others while using the theme. I know we can continue to make this a great and fun way for mods to give their corner of the web a fantastic design.
